column1: # gemdos-mc-paths.tsv -- DUMPBIOS, the further paths of TASK/FS22 after a
# media change, as far as a user program reaches them (TASK/TOOL20; FS22
# "Nachtrag Lead 2026-10-29"), against EmuTOS 1a7484ab
# (docs/analysis/ORACLE.md).
# FS22 put NewTOS' own file-system paths under the restart of a media change:
# the file selector's listing (find::list_dir), the accessory loader, the
# AUTO folder and the AES shell's direct GEMDOS calls Dsetpath, Dgetpath,
# Dsetdrv and Fdelete.  A user program reaches the GEMDOS calls those paths
# make; this table makes them after the change as EmuTOS' callers do:
#   part L  the file selector's listing: Fsfirst(<dir>\*.*, FA_SUBDIR), then
#           Fsnext to the end, into its own DTA (aes/gemfslib.c:285-310)
#   part S  Dsetpath after a change, then Dgetpath -- bdos/fsdir.c:1113
# A logical Rwabs returns E_CHNG while the change is pending
# (bios/blkdev.c:450-451), so a part that may leave it pending ends with a
# Dfree, which meets it, before the next part's read prelude.
#   part G  Dgetpath after a change: EmuTOS checks no media change there
#           (bdos/fsdir.c:1223-1224), then Dfree meets it, then Dgetpath
#           again after the re-login (which frees C:'s directory tree,
#           bdos/bdosmain.c:459-466)
#   part D  Dsetdrv / Dgetdrv after a change -- bdos/fsmain.c:420-441;
#           t:2 (what D01 returned, the dumper's drive) restores the drive
#   part F  Fdelete after a change -- bdos/fsopnclo.c:623
# The accessory loader and the AUTO folder run at boot only: no user program
# reaches them, so no case here (the TOOL20 report).
# The DTA is buffer 1 (Fsetdta), read through the layout of
# docs/api/structures/dta.md (d:dta); only Fsetdta and Fsfirst poison it.
# A path string's bytes are compared as bytes (Dgetpath, 0:16).
# WHERE IT RUNS, DESTRUCTIVE, the test image: as gemdos-mc-fs20.tsv
# (C:\DELME.TXT is deleted; the boot sector is written back unchanged).
# One table per round: a case id is the physical line number and the dump
# header carries the CRC of this file, so it is frozen once measured.
!layout
!disk
# ---- part L: the file selector's listing after a change (aes/gemfslib.c:285-310)

column5: L01 sector 0 of C: into buffer 0 (RW_NOMEDIACH)
L01 write it back unchanged, RW_NOMEDIACH: arms -- bios/blkdev.c:450-453, 473-477
L03 Fsfirst(C:\*.*, FA_SUBDIR) after the change -- bdos/bdosmain.c:449-487, bdos/fsdir.c:523
L11 sector 0 of C: into buffer 0 (RW_NOMEDIACH)
L11 write it back unchanged: arms
L13 Fsfirst(C:\SUB\*.*, FA_SUBDIR): a folder's listing after the change

column1: # ---- part S: Dsetpath after a change

column5: S01 sector 0 of C: into buffer 0 (RW_NOMEDIACH)
S01 write it back unchanged: arms
S03 Dsetpath(C:\SUB) after the change -- bdos/fsdir.c:1113
S04 Mediach(2): EmuTOS 2, Dsetpath did not meet the change
S06 Dfree(C:): meets a change still pending -- bdos/fsfat.c:337

column1: # ---- part G: Dgetpath after a change, no media check (bdos/fsdir.c:1223-1224)

column5: G00 Dsetpath(C:\SUB), no change pending -- bdos/fsdir.c:1113
G01 sector 0 of C: into buffer 0 (RW_NOMEDIACH)
G01 write it back unchanged: arms
G03 Dgetpath(C:) after the change -- bdos/fsdir.c:1229-1251
G04 Mediach(2): EmuTOS 2, Dgetpath does not meet the change
G05 Dfree(C:) meets it: re-login -- bdos/fsfat.c:337
G07 Dgetpath(C:) after the re-login -- bdos/bdosmain.c:459-466, bdos/fsdrive.c:118-131

column1: # ---- part D: Dsetdrv / Dgetdrv after a change

column5: D01 Dgetdrv: the dumper's drive, kept for t:2 -- bdos/fsmain.c:438
D02 sector 0 of C: into buffer 0 (RW_NOMEDIACH)
D02 write it back unchanged: arms
D05 Mediach(2): EmuTOS 2, Dsetdrv does not touch the drive
D09 Dgetdrv: the dumper's drive again
D10 Dfree(C:): meets a change still pending -- bdos/fsfat.c:337

column1: # ---- part F: Fdelete after a change

column5: F01 sector 0 of C: into buffer 0 (RW_NOMEDIACH)
F01 write it back unchanged: arms
F03 Fdelete(C:\DELME.TXT) after the change -- bdos/fsopnclo.c:623
